title: Catalytic property of poly(ethylene terephthalate-co-isophthalate) synthesized with a novel Sb/Al bimetallic compound catalyst
abstract: Our study investigated the hydrolysis of aluminum subacetate, and poly(ethylene terephthalate-                     co                     -isophthalate) was synthesized by using a compound catalyst made of its hydrolysate, γ-AlOOH, with ethylene glycol stibium.
